title: Legal, Regulatory and Contractual Requirements Register
instructions: CompPlus proposes entries from the selected jurisdiction, sector and compliance packs. The organisation must confirm applicability and add customer- or sector-specific obligations.

starter_rows.actions_or_controls: ROPA, lawful basis, rights handling, contracts, security, DPIA and breach process

starter_rows.why_applicable: Contractual commitments affect service, security, privacy, quality or environmental performance

starter_rows.source: Standards licensed or accessed by the organisation
starter_rows.actions_or_controls: Maintain mapped frameworks, measures, evidence, audits and management reviews
